items.title: M1 Red/Repro tests before full implementation
items.context: Write failing/negative tests first for parent DONE with open child rows, allRowsClosed=false, partial_parent_done allowed-but-not-complete, child-story-needed blocking full-roadmap claims, stale child evidence, missing child story, invalid deferred-with-human-approval, summary overclaim, and the B-43de regression shape. Do this before runtime implementation changes.
items.userSees: The user sees a failing/negative parent-roadmap totality smoke listed and then turned green before runtime implementation proceeds.

happy.desc: A red/repro smoke exists before runtime model/evaluator implementation and covers the parent-roadmap overclaim failure class.

edge.desc: The smoke includes allRowsClosed=false, partial_parent_done, child-story-needed, stale evidence, missing child story, invalid deferred-with-human-approval, summary overclaim, and B-43de-shaped cases.

adversarial.desc: The story cannot mark M1 done if tests are added only after runtime implementation or if the smoke lacks an expected-red/negative-control proof.

items.title: M2 State model and vocabulary
items.context: Implement canonical ParentRoadmapLedger row statuses, claim types, summary classes, strict validation, and round-trip persistence shape without breaking existing ProofStory records.
items.userSees: The user sees strict parent roadmap statuses and claim types accepted or rejected predictably by the smoke tests.

happy.desc: ParentRoadmapLedger, row statuses, summary classes, and claim types are exported and valid ledgers round-trip through validation.

edge.desc: Unknown statuses, invalid deferrals, and missing required closure evidence are rejected or classified invalid rather than silently closed.

adversarial.desc: A child-story-needed row remains valid data but never contributes to full roadmap closure.

items.title: M3 Parent rollup evaluator
items.context: Implement a deterministic side-effect-free evaluator that computes ParentRollupResult, allRowsClosed, row-level reasons, stale/invalid/open classifications, and next actions.
items.userSees: The user sees parent roadmap rollup output that says full, partial, blocked, or invalid with row-level next actions.

happy.desc: Evaluator returns allRowsClosed=true and full-roadmap-claim only when every row has valid closure evidence.

edge.desc: Open, stale, blocked, missing, and invalid rows produce allRowsClosed=false with row-level reasons and next actions.

adversarial.desc: No caller-provided allRowsClosed or claimType override can force a full roadmap claim against row facts.

items.title: M4 Claim consumer and summary guard
items.context: Make summary/DONE-style claim wording consume ParentRollupResult so partial_parent_done cannot be described as full roadmap completion and full-roadmap wording requires allRowsClosed true.

items.title: M5 B-5082 ProofStory binding
items.context: Bind parent-roadmap totality to originalIntentSnapshot, milestoneLedger, slicePlan, parent rollup, intentCollision, redEvidence, proofstoryContract, and done_intent_equivalence_check without weakening existing B-5082 gates.

items.title: M6 CLI and lifecycle integration
items.context: Expose parent roadmap totality through CLI and lifecycle/status surfaces in shadow/warn/enforce-compatible form. Operators need one command to see partial/full/blocked/invalid state and next actions.

items.title: M7 Migration rollout and repair
items.context: Add migration diagnostics or repair/runbook behavior for existing parent roadmap candidates such as B-43de without force-classifying historical stories as complete. Preserve evidence and rollout state.

items.title: M8 Cross-track certification
items.context: Add certification matrix proving full, partial, blocked, invalid, stale, migration, and summary paths; certify no overclaim when child rows are open and document remaining limits.
